hooks.description: Blocks whole-file reads over the line threshold; redirects to the bulk-reader subagent.
Blocks unpiped cat/head/tail/less/more dumps of large files; redirects to the bulk-reader subagent.
Blocks fresh writes and routes them by tier: templated scaffolding to the haiku code-writer subagent, derived content (tests, docs, modules against a spec) to the sonnet code-author subagent.
